reason: The build reported no original legal files in this registry package: the published archive carries its license texts only inside a LICENSES/ directory, which the harvester skips. Retain the upstream MIT and Apache-2.0 texts without altering the vendored crate or its license expression. The approved original manifest must match byte-for-byte; the archive checksum must match Cargo.lock. This is version-scoped supplemental evidence, not a general license fallback.
verification: The annotated upstream tag 2.4.0 peels to this commit, whose root Cargo.toml declares version 2.4.0. Upstream files LICENSES/MIT.txt and LICENSES/Apache-2.0.txt were fetched at this immutable revision and stored here as LICENSE-MIT and LICENSE-APACHE (byte-identical content, unchanged Git blob hashes) to satisfy the legal-filename convention; every blob hash was recomputed with git hash-object and matches the GitHub tree listing at this revision. The registry checksum was taken from the lockfile-derived contract. The build host verifies the published Cargo.toml.orig and lock checksum; the actual registry archive was not downloaded in the editing environment.
